description: REQ-001 requires that 'every other variable those files define ... MUST still be exported to the child process exactly as before' for BOTH $HOME/.hermes/.env and $HOME/.openclaw/.env (REQ-001 is framed as applying identically to both files). PROP-002 in verification-architecture.md explicitly narrows this guarantee's test coverage to only the .openclaw/.env case ('Same test file's first case -- asserts both ANICCA_HOME (preserved) and AKASH_KEY_NAME (still flows through) in one run'). The second test case (added in iteration-1 for FIND-001, .hermes/.env conflict path) defines a fixture shared secret, SOME_HERMES_SECRET, but never asserts it survives into the child process's env -- only ANICCA_HOME is checked. So the 'other variables still flow through' half of REQ-001 is untested for the .hermes/.env sourcing path, even though the underlying save/restore mechanism (which only touches ANICCA_HOME/_ANICCA_HOME_CALLER) is identical in both cases and thus not actually at risk -- but the test suite does not independently prove this for the .hermes path the way it does for .openclaw.
